title: TSMC Q1 2018 Earnings Call

passages.note: Printed pp. 3–4, C. C. Wei prepared remarks on N7 and N7+. N7 was in production as of the call. TSMC described N7+ as the enhanced N7 version, using EUV for some layers in place of immersion and reusing most tools from N7 and N10.

lineage: Participant statements in the official investor-site transcript prepared by Thomson Reuters.
